snippet.title: Supersize My Heart - Available Now! trailer
snippet.description:
Flame broil your way into the heart of one of Flavor City's most eligible bachelors in Supersize My Heart, the premier fast food mascot dating simulator available now on Steam and Itch.io! 

During the Steam Visual Novel Fest, Supersize My Heart is available for 70% off, while supplies last! (game is digital, so supplies are eternal; so that's pretty dope)!
